## Added

- **Use the Vaultwarden CLI directly** (PR #106) -- kp2bw detects [`vw`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kjanat/vaultwarden-cli) on `PATH` and prefers it over `bw`. No adapter is needed. Set `KP2BW_CLI=bw` or `KP2BW_CLI=vw` to require one installed CLI; an explicit choice never falls back to the other. Each CLI keeps its own login profile.

- **Run without installing a CLI** (PR #106) -- when neither `vw` nor `bw` is installed and `npx` is available, kp2bw runs the latest `@kjanat/vaultwarden-cli` through `npx`. It resolves the version once and runs that version offline for the rest of the migration. The download uses the public npm registry in a private npm workspace with an empty npm configuration and lifecycle scripts disabled. Log in once with `npx --yes @kjanat/vaultwarden-cli@latest login <user>`.

## Changed

- **`latest` container images no longer contain the `bw` adapter** (PR #106) -- images with the Vaultwarden CLI (`latest`, `vw` and unsuffixed or `-vw` version tags) run `vw` directly. Replace `--entrypoint bw` with `--entrypoint vw` in setup commands:

  ```bash
  docker run --rm -it --mount type=volume,src=kp2bw-state,dst=/data \
    --entrypoint vw ghcr.io/kjanat/kp2bw:latest config server https://vault.example.com
  docker run --rm -it --mount type=volume,src=kp2bw-state,dst=/data \
    --entrypoint vw ghcr.io/kjanat/kp2bw:latest login
  ```

  Existing `/data` volumes keep their login. `-bw` images still use `--entrypoint bw`.

- **`.env` sets kp2bw options and CLI profile paths only** (PR #106) -- `.env` files set `KP2BW_*` options, `BITWARDENCLI_APPDATA_DIR`, `VW_APPDATA_DIR` and `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`. Set other variables in the shell.

- **GitHub releases appear after their packages** (PR #105) -- the release page goes public only after the PyPI files and container images are downloadable.

## Security

- **Launchers in the migration directory are ignored** (PR #106) -- kp2bw locates `vw`, `bw`, `npx`, `cmd.exe` and PowerShell only in absolute `PATH` entries outside the current directory, including on Windows, where the current directory is otherwise searched implicitly. A launcher placed next to the KeePass database no longer receives the vault password.
